title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures sink, oil prices surge as markets react to Iran conflict
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，市场对伊朗冲突做出反应，油价飙升
summary: Wall Street is reacting to joint attacks from the US and Israel on Iran. Oil and currencies have seen the greatest jumps.
summary_zh: 华尔街正在对美国和以色列对伊朗的联合攻击做出反应。石油和货币的涨幅最大。

title: Amazon India slashes seller referral fees in retail growth push
title_zh: 亚马逊印度大幅削减卖家推荐费以推动零售增长
summary: March 2 (Reuters) - Amazon will stop charging sellers in India referral fees for products under 1,000 rupees ($10.98), the company said on Monday, as it looks to attract more merchants to its online
summary_zh: 路透 3 月 2 日 - 亚马逊周一表示，将停止向印度卖家收取 1,000 卢比（10.98 美元）以下产品的推荐费，以吸引更多商家使用其在线产品

title: NFL quarterback Jameis Winston on how he turned from burning through cash to investing strategically
title_zh: NFL 四分卫杰梅斯·温斯顿 (Jameis Winston) 讲述他如何从烧钱转向战略投资
summary: Winston's costly evolution is a reminder to "be where your feet are" and invest in companies you know.
summary_zh: 温斯顿代价高昂的演变提醒我们“脚踏实地”并投资于您认识的公司。

title: "A stark contrast": Wall Street weighs winners and losers amid AI-driven tech sell-off
title_zh: “形成鲜明对比”：华尔街在人工智能驱动的科技股抛售中权衡赢家和输家
summary: Wall Street strategists see key distinctions among certain names in tech in the near term.
summary_zh: 华尔街策略师认为，短期内科技领域的某些名字之间存在关键区别。

title: Here's the great Nvidia stock mystery
title_zh: 这是英伟达股票的巨大谜团
summary: Nvidia could use some sizzle, or so thinks the market.
summary_zh: 市场认为英伟达可以利用一些热度。

title: February jobs data, Broadcom earnings, and AI fears abound: What to watch this week
title_zh: 2 月份就业数据、博通财报和人工智能担忧比比皆是：本周值得关注的内容
summary: After Nvidia's earnings failed to impress investors and sent the market into a downturn, attention turns this week to quarterly results from Broadcom and more worries about the state of the AI trade.
summary_zh: 在英伟达的盈利未能给投资者留下深刻印象并导致市场陷入低迷之后，本周的注意力转向博通的季度业绩以及对人工智能行业状况的更多担忧。

title: Mining stocks are the new market darlings, fueled by geopolitical risks and AI demand
title_zh: 在地缘政治风险和人工智能需求的推动下，矿业股成为市场新宠
summary: Mining stocks are rising as the sector becomes a strategic long-term asset for investors.
summary_zh: 随着矿业股成为投资者的战略性长期资产，矿业股正在上涨。
